label: Tutorial: Rule formats
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Rule formats page (endpoint rule.rule_formats). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Every supported format
steps.text: YARA, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek, CRS, Wazuh, NOVA and more: search one to see what it detects.

steps.title: A card per format
steps.text: How many rules, the validator used, and the formats each one can be exported to.
